author: Zegita
body:
As you can see by the title we are only looking for defenders. The chances of you getting accepted for another position is very low due to the fact we are basically full but require defenders. Most of us are experienced players and we are around the EU region. You can still be accepted if you are US/SA its just whether or not you are active. 

ROSTER

Good luck.
